notes.title: My wife was diagnosed with breast cancer, so I had to take a break for a while.
notes.content:
[b]Thanks for using my app.[/b]

Last year, my wife was diagnosed with breast cancer, so, I had to take a break from my indie development.

Thankfully, her surgery and follow-up treatment went well, so now I can spend my full time for my indiedev.

[h1]What’s coming next for VRM Posing Desktop[/h1]

I'll keep actively following any updates to the VRM format going forward.

If you’re interested in the release history or upcoming updates, feel free to check out the link below.

[url=https://elvneko.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=751cd57509704b3d834d02774f878701&pvs=4]https://elvneko.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=751cd57509704b3d834d02774f878701&pvs=4[/url]

[b]Next update plan[/b]
[list]
[*] remaking HUD(user interface) to easy to understand
[*] making official document
[*] change pose json type from Unity HumanPose Class for flexible pose saving
[/list]

[h1]Quick notice[/h1]

I changed my business name to ElvNeko, because I wanted to switch my mindset.

"Neko" means "cat" in Japanese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/f426fd1be1f91446f513a850faee80939e35582e.png[/img]

My previous brand names often made people think I was good at speaking English, so this time I wanted to choose a short name that reflects my Japanese roots.

Recently, I’ve been working on 3D modeling my mascot character in Blender and giving Unreal Engine rendering a try.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/ffd069f7d20e66e28b57d5c7745d83f2a5306ae8.png[/img]

Right now, I'm interested in Blender, Unreal Engine, and languages like C++ and Rust.
I’m actively learning these and want to keep developing apps and games that will help creators in the future.

If you're even a little bit interested in my progress, I’d be happy if you checked out from my social media.

[list]
[*] YouTube [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ElvNeko]https://www.youtube.com/@ElvNeko[/url]
[*] Bluesky [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elvneko.com]https://bsky.app/profile/elvneko.com[/url]
[/list]

I’ve also started using some other social media from last week.
[list]
[*] Threads [url=https://www.threads.net/@elv_neko]https://www.threads.net/@elv_neko[/url]
[*] Instagram [url=https://www.instagram.com/elv_neko/]https://www.instagram.com/elv_neko/[/url]
[/list]

Thank you for reading to the end.
I hope that my app can help your creative works in some small way.

notes.title: [Version 4.0.8] vrm 1.0 support
notes.content:
[h1][Version 4.0.8] vrm 1.0 support[/h1]

I updated VRoid SDK to v0.3.0 and UniVRM to 0.113.0.

And so, now VRM Posing Desktop can import vrm1.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/69b053d3fd09638cf86913c3d79aa99454b39012.png[/img]

[h2]Changes due to the UniVRM10 impact[/h2]

Due to MToon10 specifications, shadow color and appearance may differ from MToon when importing Series 0 models.

Related UniVRM issues.
* ShadeColor is not multiplying in MToon10
[url=https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2037]https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2037[/url]

* In VRM 1.0, I would like the influence from light sources to be the same level as the old Shader (VRM/MToon).
[url=https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2147]https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/issues/2147[/url]

Other changes compared to version 4.0.7 include

* Deleted the ability to limit the wind function's area of influence to hair only.

* When using the Save Camera Transform or Save Scene functions in previous versions, characters and Props will be flipped 180 degrees. I apologize for the inconvenience, but please re-save the scene or camera with the new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/a61473e5c196a9e3914c2c3dff15b6e28cc69aa2.png[/img]

[h2]Update Schedule[/h2]
I want to support VRM Animation format as pose, for which a draft has recently been released.

The update schedule is maintained at the following URL

[url=https://evelyngamedev.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=0730ec2c3c4e432fb9647e8495470641&pvs=4]https://evelyngamedev.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=0730ec2c3c4e432fb9647e8495470641&pvs=4[/url]

I hope VRM Posing Desktop will be useful for your creative activities.

notes.title: Transparent Ground for Shadow etc.
notes.content:
[h1]Shadow Function[/h1]

Added transparent ground that can project a shadow with respect to Y-coordinate 0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/d2ff17a00f7ff9caed5cca3aa0ca7fe6868bcb8f.jpg[/img]

Changing the color tint or transparency to the shadow changes the parameters of the transparent ground material.

They do not interfere with the shadows reflected in the Props.

Also, it cannot be used in conjunction with Point Light in Props.

If you know of a transparency shader that can also render shadows from Point Light, I would appreciate it if you could let me know.

[h1]Shadow from Point Light[/h1]

Create shadows with Point Light.

The shadows of Point Light are now projected on objects placed with Props.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/4335210aee91271aa94b53dfbe62afeed739ced8.jpg[/img]

As mentioned above, this is not compatible with the transparent ground shader for shadows, so please turn off the shadow function when using Point Light.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pose registration to shortcut keys to Shift+1~9,A~Z
[*] Switching background operation
[*] etc.
[/list]

The update schedule can be found here.

https://evelyngamedev.notion.site/11337098773e464d95d6d0fd06bea85e?v=0730ec2c3c4e432fb9647e8495470641

Best of luck to you in your creative works.

notes.title: [Version3.2.8] RGBA sliders for Effect Props / Post-Effects of Unity Default
notes.content:
[h1]Version3.2.8[/h1]

[h2]Color Change function of Effect Props[/h2]

Effect Props color change enabled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/e8ec36c553d2df688dab1e134a51b7dea70d858d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Adding more Post Processing[/h2]

[h3]Bloom[/h3]

Produces fringes of light extending from the borders of bright areas of the image, creating the effect of an overflow of very bright light when the camera, or the eye, captures the scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/86882dde14cbed6b7fddd8174352fbab43e84974.jpg[/img]

[h3]Grain[/h3]

Small particles of film coarsen the image and make it appear unprocessed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/c1bea10a0ccb0f264a09da5e4ad5e93b8e138125.jpg[/img]

[h3]Vignette[/h3]

Darkens the edges of the image and lightens the center of the image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/9055a7f902fc509274388d6d5058d8905ad9c8ce.jpg[/img]

[h3]AmbientOcclusion[/h3]

Darkens creases, holes, intersections, and surfaces that are close to each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/ef85ae143e04490ca8d2655276052431b26c9ad3.jpg[/img]

[h3]ChromaticAberration[/h3]

Real world phenomena produced by the camera lens not converging all colors to a single point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/4a5d48d806fe8d58cc3afcd09f92e9afb8d3d4aa.jpg[/img]

[h3]ColorGrading[/h3]

Changes and modifications to color and brightness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/62c03055d253af7828130376f539a19fff40c86d.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[h1]Version3.0.7[/h1]

Version 3.0.7 includes many functional improvements.

I invite you to upload your favorite saved poses to SteamWorkshop.

notes.title: [Version2.0.8] Major UI redesign / Camera control and character manipulation
notes.content:
I plan to implement multiple characters next week. Therefore, I have made significant changes to the UI design and camera operation in version 2.0.8.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/651174ac085f60936e4c7e59a58c0e025865a125.jpg[/img]

[h1]Newly designed controls[/h1]
[list]
[*] Left click: UI selection/character selection (the previous left-click-and-drag camera-around function is no longer available)
[*] Mouse wheel: Zoom in/out
[*] Mouse wheel pressed in & dragged: camera coordinates moved
[*] Right click & drag: camera direction
[*] Scene Gizmo
[*] Character Transform Gizmo (Move / Rotate / Scale)
[/list]


[h1]Other updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Screen switching has been eliminated to allow for seamless operation.
[*] The IP address and port for the VMC protocol are now retained even when the application is closed.
[*] Undo and Redo are now possible while customizing poses.
[*] Changed file browser to work with native OS.
[*] Camera viewing angle can now be changed.
[/list]

Thanks to the improvements based on your feedback, the official Windows Twitter account has praised my app.

https://twitter.com/EvelynSoloDev/status/1512451863785795588?s=20&t=rXS3Wro1mBaJKX-nAgktdQ

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/1b73ea680710e14ce79709c2ddc7c634e9628c07.jpg[/img]

I'll continue to work hard on updates. The list of feature improvements is at the following URL
https://evelyngamedev.notion.site/5bb7e50c57564d66ba72eca8aa9dc6f9?v=3e6aac0ab4ce4394bea23f903a937fe0

I hope that VRM Posing Desktop can contribute to your creative process in some small way.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41927856/651174ac085f60936e4c7e59a58c0e025865a125.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fixed VRM files not loading for some people🙇‍♀️
notes.content:
Since version 2.0.0, some people were unable to load VRM files.

[b]Cause:.[/b]
An error was occurring during UniVRM runtime loading that the standard shaders could not be found.

[b]Solution:.[/b]
Changed Unity build files to always include standard shaders.

I was only using 3D models with MToon myself, so I was not aware of this event.

Thanks to everyone who DM'd me.

I hope the VRM Posing Desktop continues to be a useful tool in your activities🙇‍♀️
